summary: Iteration 25: Tested the new filter system for Ranking de Equipes page. All features working correctly - replaced 'Mensal', 'Anual', 'Histórico' tabs with 'Nacional', 'Estadual', 'Cidade', 'Histórico'. Month dropdown filter shows only months from January to current month (March 2026). Backend accepts mes=1-12 parameter correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Ranking de Equipes page now has 4 tabs: Nacional (filters nationally), Estadual (shows Estado dropdown), Cidade (shows Estado and Cidade dropdowns), Histórico (no month filter, shows all-time data). The month dropdown (📅 Mês:) appears on all tabs EXCEPT Histórico. It shows only months from January to the current month (March 2026 in this case). The backend endpoint /api/liga-assessorias/ranking accepts tipo=nacional|estadual|cidade|historico and mes=1-12 parameters.
